method: Independently reopened primary sources with web, checked the named claim scope; paraphrases, not long quotations

sources.name: Vernon I
sources.supports: PDF p2: persisted versions reject stale client updates; invariant boundary matters more than graph composition.

sources.name: Vernon II
sources.supports: Identity references do not put another aggregate in the same boundary; Reasons To Break the Rules explicitly discusses deliberate exceptions. Concurrency failure can retry without acknowledgement.

sources.name: Fowler Bounded Context
sources.supports: A large domain may use different internally consistent models/vocabularies with explicit relationships; not a deployment-per-class rule.

sources.name: Transactional outbox
sources.supports: Publication obligation is stored with the business transaction and later relayed; publication before durable marking can repeat.

sources.name: Idempotent Consumer
sources.supports: Processed-message identity is inserted inside the business transaction; its unique subscriber/message key detects duplicates.

sources.name: PostgreSQL18 locking
sources.supports: Conflicting row writers wait until transaction completion; lock ordering and deadlock handling matter. The chapter 10ms number is not a product benchmark.

sources.name: PostgreSQL18 isolation
sources.supports: READ COMMITTED re-evaluates UPDATE predicates after concurrent commits; DO NOTHING can meet an initially invisible conflict; known serialization aborts need transaction retry.

sources.name: Stripe idempotency
sources.supports: Current page distinguishes API v1 first-response retention and parameter matching/pruning from v2 recovery semantics. Pruned v1 keys may start new requests; no automatic UNKNOWN expiry follows.

sources.name: Stripe webhooks
sources.supports: Raw-body signature verification; duplicate event IDs and separate event objects can represent the same object/type; generation order is not guaranteed for delivery.

sources.name: Fowler Event Sourcing
sources.supports: Authoritative sequence of state changes permits reconstruction; current-state tables plus outbox notifications alone are not event sourcing.

limitations: Teaching lifecycle, capacity, IDs and refund policies are local assumptions; no live provider experiments.
